Lead the Data Science, Machine Learning and Engineering (DSE) team at an AdTech firm operating an OpenRTB Exchange, SSP, DSP and DMP. Manage 6 data scientists and 3 Java/Python engineers across 5 time zones, owning planning, performance tracking, hiring, onboarding, mentoring, Agile/Scrum delivery and 3rd-line on-call support. Delivered 3 internal services, 5 ML models and 20 quarterly plans; migrated all DSE/ML projects to a new data center in 3 months.

Designed a distributed DMP on asynchronous Java, gRPC, Cassandra and Redis serving 30 billion entities at p99 5ms. Built an RTB supply scoring model that cut servers by 50%, a CatBoost/Lucene supply predictor processing 24M documents daily, and a Spring/Netty web crawler for ads.txt and app-ads.txt covering 500K domains daily. Delivered a gRPC/REST domain attribution service at 100K QPS, a JSQ client-side load balancer with circuit breakers cutting p95 latency to 1ms, and a containerized DoubleVerify cluster at 300K QPS.

Built ETL pipelines and an audience builder with Luigi, Hive, Presto, Trino and Impala; Jupyter reporting/alerting; Docker images and TestContainers-style integration tests; and Kubernetes (K8S) and Linux deployments. Developed ML models for look-alike audiences, video completion rate, gender prediction (Bayes, SQL, Scikit-learn), win-rate and avails, NPI attribution for HCP targeting, ICD10 attribution on clean-room prescription data for DTC audiences, with a secure Flask/Gunicorn facade on Google Cloud.

Delivered PyTorch embedding models (Contrastive Learning, HDBSCAN, Optuna, TensorBoard) on Google BigQuery and Cloud Storage, an app store scraper, a multi-GPU medical semantic encoder (Lightning, Hugging Face Transformers), a medical entity extractor (GLiNER, UMLS) and contextualizer via FastAPI, versioned model storage (Nginx, CherryPy), a Streamlit/Plotly visualizer, and an AI/LLM agent "Council" (ACP, Copilot CLI) automating model improvement.
